Question: Dear Hazrat My mother died on Dec'09. I was her eldest son. I live in Dhaka. Before she died she came to my house. I quarrelled with her severely because she wanted some money to repair our native house at Jhenaidah (our district). I refused to pay. Besides I was frustrated helping my parents, brother and sisters. Now often I dreamt her and quarrel with her and cry in the dream. Please answer the meaning of the dream and advice. Kindest regards Aktar Hossain Answer ID: 24460 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1236/971/D=1431) You should do isal-o-sawab for your mother extensively. Try to please her soul by reciting the holy Quran, doing charity and sadqah . Also, treat her successors with good manner and keep on reciting this dua: رب ارحمهما كما ربيانى صغيراً. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
